links.outcome: Extraction accuracy against expert reference review of trial annotations
links.effect: Expert review of 42 trials: 88.1% of studies correctly annotated; 80% precision at individual eligibility criterion level.
links.quote: Expert review of 42 trials showed that 88.1% of studies were correctly annotated, with a precision of 80% at the level of individual eligibility criteria.

links.outcome: Hallucinated genes and misinterpreted abbreviations in LLM extraction
links.effect: Failures were mainly due to hallucinated genes and misinterpreted abbreviations; precision 80% at criterion level.
links.quote: Failures were mainly due to hallucinated genes and misinterpreted abbreviations, highlighting challenges in biomedical text processing.

unlisted_practices: Rule-based validation of LLM-extracted gene names against HUGO Gene Nomenclature

screen.reason: The study describes the integration and evaluation of an LLM-based tool into an operational platform (CATS) for extracting genetic eligibility criteria from clinical trials, evaluated via expert review.
